original_idea: 我想研究利用机器学习或深度学习模型，基于公开 ICU 临床数据预测患者发生急性肾损伤的风险。请分析目前是否已经有类似研究、已有研究主要采用哪些方法、可能存在什么研究差异，以及这个想法在数据、方法、算力和验证方面是否具有可行性。

evidence.quote: Methodologically, ML was applied in this study for AKI prediction, consistent with recent advances in ICU-based predictive modeling .
In addition, SHAP analysis identified 17 key risk factors associated with AKI in critically ill patients, most of which have been widely recognized in clinical practice.
